summary.text: Joe Pike is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 6 in Harnett County since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as business owner and president of Twisted Grape Investments Inc.

paragraphs.text: Joe Pike assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Paul O'Neal (R).
The General Assembly lists two terms in the House for Pike.
Ballotpedia reports that Pike advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
